description: RLS columns (classification, tenant_id) on studio_event_sources, studio_workflow_triggers and studio_trigger_events. Migrations 305 and 309 added them to studio_workflows and the run tables; the event tables from migration 304 were missed, so get_connection()'s request-context predicate produced 'no such column: classification' on every dashboard read. The list helpers catch broadly and return [], so the trigger subsystem rendered as empty rather than erroring — silently unreachable in the UI while every unit test, which runs outside a request context, stayed green
